svg.aria-label: Video upload flow. Flow a: 1 the client uploads the video to original blob storage; 2 transcoding servers fetch and transcode it; 3a the results go to transcoded storage and 3a.1 on to the CDN; in parallel 3b a completion event is queued, and 3b.1 a completion handler 3b.1a updates the metadata cache and 3b.1b the metadata database; 4 the API servers tell the client the video is ready. Flow b, at the same time: the client sends the video's metadata to the API servers, which save it.
svg.title: Video upload flow
